description: Victorian Coastal Inundation Sea Level Rise 2009 (series on South Australian Government Data Directory) is a series of datasets listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. The Victorian Coastal Inundation Dataset (the product) is a digital dataset consisting of eight spatial layers modelling the extent of land subject to coastal inundation due to projected sea level rise from 2009 to 2100. Coverage: South Australia. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are atmosphere, meteorology, Climatology. It offers 9 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-08-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
